premise: Vendors trade unfinished weather patterns—fogs, monsoons, and wind corridors—beneath a planet-scale engine before sky release.
simulation_objective: Simulate trade of weather lots that dynamically alter visibility, navigation, and social leverage across six market rooms.
economy_focus: Climate craft, delivery disputes, and barometric arbitrage.
exploration_focus: Navigating shifting visibility and route changes caused by active weather lots.
conflict_tone: High-stakes bargaining and public safety risks from unstable climate containers.
visual_style: Storm-gray and wet charcoal palette with celadon and electric-yellow accents; no text or logos.

item_catalog.image_prompt: Ornate charcoal metal device with a glass tube of glowing celadon liquid, electric-yellow dial markings.

item_catalog.name: Dispute Resolution Bolt
item_catalog.description: A captured lightning strike used to settle delivery arguments through overwhelming force.
item_catalog.image_prompt: A jagged shard of electric-yellow energy contained within a storm-gray glass cylinder.

item_catalog.name: Petrified Thunderstone
item_catalog.description: A dense rock that vibrates with a low-frequency hum, remnants of a storm that never broke.
item_catalog.image_prompt: Rough charcoal-colored stone with glowing celadon veins, sitting on a wet surface.

item_catalog.name: Cirrus Veil Umbrella
item_catalog.description: An umbrella that doesn't block rain, but converts it into a fine, breathable mist.
item_catalog.image_prompt: An open umbrella made of translucent celadon silk, charcoal ribs, electric-yellow handle.

item_catalog.name: Barometric Arbitrage Scale
item_catalog.description: A balance used to weigh the value of a storm against the cost of a clear sky.
item_catalog.image_prompt: Sleek charcoal metal scales with celadon glass pans, glowing yellow balance indicator.

item_catalog.name: Squall-in-a-Box
item_catalog.description: A compact wooden crate that releases a 30-second gale when opened.
item_catalog.image_prompt: Dark charcoal wooden box with celadon metal bands, wind visible leaking from the seams.

item_catalog.name: Dew-Point Collector
item_catalog.description: A mesh glove that pulls drinkable water directly from the humid night air.
item_catalog.image_prompt: A glove made of fine celadon wire mesh, dripping with water, electric-yellow accents at the wrist.

item_catalog.name: Thunderhead Ink
item_catalog.description: Ink that rumbles audibly when used to write contracts.
item_catalog.image_prompt: A small charcoal glass bottle filled with swirling dark gray liquid and yellow sparks.

item_catalog.name: Anemometer Staff
item_catalog.description: A walking stick topped with spinning cups that generates power from the market's drafts.
item_catalog.image_prompt: A tall charcoal staff with spinning celadon cups at the top, glowing yellow energy core.

agent_visual_policy.world_wardrobe_brief: Attire for a high-stakes meteorological market under a planet-scale engine. Clothing must be moisture-resistant, wind-resilient, and utility-focused, featuring specialized gear for containing and manipulating unfinished weather patterns.

role_style_rules.palette_notes: Heavy use of celadon and magenta accents over charcoal bases.
role_style_rules.silhouette_notes: Flowing but contained silhouettes to avoid wind-drag.

role_style_rules.palette_notes: Dominant storm-gray with sharp electric-yellow highlights.
role_style_rules.silhouette_notes: Sharp, vertical lines emphasizing status and precision.

role_style_rules.palette_notes: Darkest charcoal tones with high-contrast yellow safety markers.
role_style_rules.silhouette_notes: Top-heavy utility focus with visible back-mounted equipment.

default_rule.palette_notes: Muted grays and slates with minimal accent colors.
default_rule.silhouette_notes: Compact and shrouded to protect from shifting weather.

visual_consistency_rules: Maintain 1px selective dark charcoal outlines for all sprites.
Back-mounted weather vessels must be color-coded to role.
All metallic elements must use oxidized copper or brass tones.
No text or symbols; use color and silhouette for role identification.

visual_canon.world_prompt_prefix: top-down pixel art, night market, wet charcoal floors, celadon instruments, storm-gray atmosphere, no text
visual_canon.sprite_prompt_prefix: top-down pixel art sprite, weather vendor, kite silk clothing, holding meteorological tool, no text
